headline.en: She leaves the house before the traffic.
headline.bm: Dia keluar dari rumah sebelum jalan sesak.

what_she_gets.en: Collected at her own front gate
A chaperone brings her to the van in her chair
what_she_gets.bm: Teman iringan membawanya ke van dengan kerusi roda

what_she_gets.en: She stays in her own wheelchair
what_she_gets.bm: Dia kekal di atas kerusi rodanya sendiri

headline.en: She never leaves her own chair. It is strapped to the floor.
headline.bm: Dia tidak pernah keluar dari kerusinya sendiri. Kerusi itu diikat pada lantai.

what_she_gets.en: Rolls up a factory fitted ramp
what_she_gets.bm: Naik melalui tanjakan yang dipasang dari kilang
Kerusi diikat kemas dengan tali keselamatan

headline.en: In at the door, not left at the kerb.
headline.bm: Diiring masuk ke pintu, bukan ditinggalkan di tepi jalan.

what_she_gets.en: Walked in to the dialysis centre
Registration and queue handled for her
Someone stays with her through the treatment

headline.en: Home again, by the same person who took her.
headline.bm: Pulang ke rumah, bersama orang yang sama yang membawanya pergi.

what_she_gets.en: Wheeled right to her own door
The same trained chaperone both ways
what_she_gets.bm: Teman iringan terlatih yang sama, pergi dan balik

what_she_gets.en: Regular runs can be billed monthly
what_she_gets.bm: Perjalanan tetap boleh dibil setiap bulan
